class.name: NetwPlayer
class.brief_description: A player whose join was accepted.
class.description: The session creates one [NetwPlayer] when it accepts a join, and always returns the same object for it, so it can be compared with [code]==[/code] and used as a [Dictionary] key. A connected peer that has not joined has none. [codeblock] var player := Netw.of(self).peer_get_player(peer_id) greet(player.username) for body: NetwEntity in player.bodies: follow(body.owner) [/codeblock] A player is not a peer. After the player leaves, [member is_active] is [code]false[/code], even if a new player connects with the same [member peer_id].

members.member: The entities spawned for this player with [method Netw.spawn_player], in no particular order. Empty for a spectator.
[code]false[/code] once the player has left. Check it before using a player you stored.
The peer this player is connected as. Another player may reuse it after this one leaves.
The username from [method Netw.prepare_join]. It is kept after the player leaves. Two players may join with the same name, unless [method Netw.configure_admission] refuses it.
